text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond took a brilliant 1st place. 
However, her expression remained somber.

Fatigue made her legs feel heavy in the 
final stretch, preventing her from running 
satisfactorily. She felt dejected, 
believing her performance was unworthy of 
a "famous Umamusume."

The cause of the fatigue was having to run 
all the way to the racetrack to avoid 
being late due to traffic.

Satono Diamond wondered if this too was 
because of the jinx.

And she fired herself up, determined to 
overcome any jinx and seize victory with a 
flawless run in the upcoming Japanese 
Derby.
